name: Bidding on projects at Freelancer.com
summary: Bid on client projects posted to Freelancer.com's marketplace; the platform takes a fee on each project you're awarded.
whatYouDo: You create a profile and bid on posted projects. If a client awards you a project and you accept, you deliver the work in milestones while Freelancer.com takes its project fee, then you withdraw your balance.
appeal: Lots of posted projects to bid on
Fees are listed on an official fees page
A program lets you bring your own clients at 0% (older terms, may have changed)
watchOuts: On fixed-price work the project fee is 10% or $5 USD, whichever is greater, and it's collected when you accept the award
Hourly work costs 10% of each payment, and enterprise projects 15%
Official fee pages give inconsistent prices for upgrades and listings
Complaint boards (2011–2024) report suspended accounts and funds held pending identity or transaction checks
Withdrawals cost about $1 USD for PayPal, Skrill or Payoneer (wires cost more), and Freelancer uses its own exchange rate
Payout options for Canada weren't confirmed in this check

compensation.notes: You set your bids. No earnings data was checked. Take-home pay is after the project fee, withdrawal fees and currency conversion.

reliability.notes: Work depends on winning bids. No official data on award rates.

fees: Project fee on fixed-price work is 10% or $5 USD (whichever is greater), collected when you accept. Hourly work costs 10% per payment and enterprise projects 15%. Upgrades and memberships are optional and paid. Withdrawals cost about $1 USD for PayPal, Skrill or Payoneer; wires cost more (one third-party guide says $25 USD).
applicationSteps: Create a profile and complete identity verification early to avoid payment holds
Bid on projects that match your skills
Accept awarded projects (the project fee is collected at this point)
Deliver through milestones and withdraw your balance
fitsIf: You're comfortable competing on bids and can handle a fee taken when you accept a project.
notFitIf: You're new, have little to spare for fees, or need fast, reliable access to your money.

sources.title: Freelancer Fees and Charges, Earn And Save More!
sources.notes: From a search summary: freelancer fees are 10% or $5 USD (whichever is greater) on fixed-price work, collected on acceptance, and 10% of hourly payments. Enterprise projects are 15%. Card, PayPal and Skrill transactions cost $0.30 + 2.3%, and withdrawals about $1 USD. Upgrade prices differ across official pages. Direct fetch was blocked.

sources.title: Project Fees
sources.notes: Support page on project fees, summarised together with the fees page above. Direct fetch was blocked.

sources.title: Freelancer.com - account suspension without explanation and withholding of funds
sources.notes: A 2024 complaint (anecdote): an account was suspended with no specific reason and about $200–300 held. Freelancer.com has replied to such complaints that it freezes accounts only to verify identity or transactions.

sources.title: freelancercom product guide
sources.notes: Notes user dissatisfaction with account verification and cases of funds withheld from unverified accounts.

sources.title: Freelancer Review: All you need to know
sources.notes: Says most withdrawal methods are free except wires ($25 USD). This conflicts with other sources' figure of about $1, so check before relying on it.
